workflow.generatedExactSource:
name: Reproduce FFmpeg without Docker

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      core:
        description: FFmpeg core to reproduce
        required: true
        default: all
        type: choice
        options:
          - all
          - within-remux
          - within-direct
          - within-mpeg4
          - within-webm
          - within-vp9
          - within-webm-quality
          - within-theora
          - within-aiff
          - within-h264-candidate
          - within-mpeg2-candidate
          - within-mpeg2-split-contract
          - within-mpeg2-split-properties
          - within-mpeg2-split-encoder
          - within-mpeg2-split-pipeline
          - within-mpeg2-aligned-reuse
          - within-h264-vaa-arithmetic
          - within-h264-sad-arithmetic
      h264_memory_mib:
        description: Fixed memory for the private H264 candidate only
        required: false
        default: '64'
        type: choice
        options:
          - '32'
          - '64'
      h264_library_lto:
        description: Whole-library LTO for the private H264 speed experiment only
        required: false
        default: '0'
        type: choice
        options:
          - '0'
          - '1'
      h264_vaa_simd:
        description: Exact-result private H264 VAA SIMD experiment only
        required: false
        default: '0'
        type: choice
        options:
          - '0'
          - '1'
      h264_sad_simd:
        description: Proven exact-result private H264 SAD SIMD experiment only
        required: false
        default: '0'
        type: choice
        options:
          - '0'
          - '1'

      h264_allocator_diagnostic:
        description: Bounded native allocator sampling for a private diagnostic only
        required: false
        default: '0'
        type: choice
        options:
          - '0'
          - '1'

      mpeg2_frame_allocation_diagnostic:
        description: Private scalar plane attribution only, never acceptance
        required: false
        default: '0'
        type: choice
        options:
          - '0'
          - '1'

      mpeg2_decoder_set:
        description: Additional private decoder module, broad default retained
        required: false
        default: wide
        type: choice
        options:
          - wide
          - hevc-mpeg4

      mpeg2_allocator:
        description: Private fixed-32-MiB allocation strategy, never acceptance
        required: false
        default: emmalloc
        type: choice
        options:
          - emmalloc
          - dlmalloc

      mpeg2_allocator_diagnostic:
        description: Fixed-heap MPEG2 allocation diagnosis only, never acceptance
        required: false
        default: '0'
        type: choice
        options:
          - '0'
          - '1'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: reproduce-ffmpeg-nondocker
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  reproduce-ffmpeg:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 120
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install native build prerequisites
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
            autoconf automake ca-certificates curl libtool make patch \
            pkg-config xz-utils

      - name: Install pinned Emscripten SDK without Docker
        shell: bash
        run: |
          mkdir -p work/sdk-tmp
          export TMPDIR="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/work/sdk-tmp"
          git clone --filter=blob:none --no-checkout \
            https://github.com/emscripten-core/emsdk.git work/emsdk
          git -C work/emsdk checkout 224ec5f9f2f72f09f9ce0e26d66bae7dbd8b692f
          test "$(git -C work/emsdk rev-parse HEAD)" = \
            "224ec5f9f2f72f09f9ce0e26d66bae7dbd8b692f"
          work/emsdk/emsdk install 6.0.4
          work/emsdk/emsdk activate 6.0.4

      - name: Rebuild and compare requested FFmpeg module(s)
        shell: bash
        env:
          WITHIN_KEEP_NONDOCKER_OUTPUT: "1"
          WITHIN_BUILD_CORE_FILTER: ${{ inputs.core }}
        run: |
          source work/emsdk/emsdk_env.sh
          if test "${{ inputs.core }}" = within-h264-sad-arithmetic; then
            export PATH="$(dirname "$EMSDK_NODE"):$PATH"
            bash media/ffmpeg/verify-sad-arithmetic.sh
          elif test "${{ inputs.core }}" = within-h264-vaa-arithmetic; then
            export PATH="$(dirname "$EMSDK_NODE"):$PATH"
            bash media/ffmpeg/verify-vaa-arithmetic.sh
          elif test "${{ inputs.core }}" = within-h264-candidate; then
            export PATH="$(dirname "$EMSDK_NODE"):$PATH"
            WITHIN_H264_MEMORY_MIB="${{ inputs.h264_memory_mib || '64' }}" \
              WITHIN_H264_LIBRARY_LTO="${{ inputs.h264_library_lto || '0' }}" \
              WITHIN_H264_VAA_SIMD="${{ inputs.h264_vaa_simd || '0' }}" \
              WITHIN_H264_SAD_SIMD="${{ inputs.h264_sad_simd || '0' }}" \
              WITHIN_H264_ALLOCATOR_DIAGNOSTIC="${{ inputs.h264_allocator_diagnostic || '0' }}" \
              WITHIN_KEEP_H264_CANDIDATE=1 bash media/ffmpeg/build-h264-candidate.sh
          elif test "${{ inputs.core }}" = within-mpeg2-split-contract; then
            export PATH="$(dirname "$EMSDK_NODE"):$PATH"
            bash media/ffmpeg/verify-mpeg2-split-frame.sh
          elif test "${{ inputs.core }}" = within-mpeg2-split-properties; then
            export PATH="$(dirname "$EMSDK_NODE"):$PATH"
            bash media/ffmpeg/verify-mpeg2-split-properties.sh
          elif test "${{ inputs.core }}" = within-mpeg2-split-encoder; then
            export PATH="$(dirname "$EMSDK_NODE"):$PATH"
            bash media/ffmpeg/build-mpeg2-split-encoder.sh
          elif test "${{ inputs.core }}" = within-mpeg2-split-pipeline; then
            export PATH="$(dirname "$EMSDK_NODE"):$PATH"
            bash media/ffmpeg/build-mpeg2-split-pipeline.sh
          elif test "${{ inputs.core }}" = within-mpeg2-aligned-reuse; then
            export PATH="$(dirname "$EMSDK_NODE"):$PATH"
            node media/ffmpeg/build-mpeg2-late-refstruct.mjs
          elif test "${{ inputs.core }}" = within-mpeg2-candidate; then
            export PATH="$(dirname "$EMSDK_NODE"):$PATH"
            WITHIN_MPEG2_ALLOCATOR_DIAGNOSTIC="${{ inputs.mpeg2_allocator_diagnostic || '0' }}" \
              WITHIN_MPEG2_ALLOCATOR="${{ inputs.mpeg2_allocator || 'emmalloc' }}" \
              WITHIN_MPEG2_DECODER_SET="${{ inputs.mpeg2_decoder_set || 'wide' }}" \
              WITHIN_MPEG2_FRAME_ALLOCATION_DIAGNOSTIC="${{ inputs.mpeg2_frame_allocation_diagnostic || '0' }}" \
              WITHIN_KEEP_MPEG2_CANDIDATE=1 bash media/ffmpeg/build-mpeg2-candidate.sh
          else
            bash media/ffmpeg/reproduce-nondocker.sh
          fi

      - name: Retain private H264 candidate and corresponding sources
        if: success() && inputs.core == 'within-h264-candidate'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: private-h264-candidate-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            work/h264-candidate-output/*.mjs
            work/h264-candidate-output/*.wasm
            work/h264-candidate-output/*.symbols
            work/h264-candidate-output/build-manifest.json
            work/h264-candidate-output/config_components.h
            work/h264-candidate-output/LICENSE.*
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1

      - name: Retain corresponding source and configure diagnostics separately
        if: success() && inputs.core == 'within-h264-candidate'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: private-h264-source-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            work/h264-candidate-output/corresponding-source.tar.gz
            work/h264-candidate-output/configure.log
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1

      - name: Retain private MPEG2 candidate
        if: success() && inputs.core == 'within-mpeg2-candidate'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: private-mpeg2-candidate-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            work/mpeg2-candidate-output/*.mjs
            work/mpeg2-candidate-output/*.wasm
            work/mpeg2-candidate-output/*.symbols
            work/mpeg2-candidate-output/build-manifest.json
            work/mpeg2-candidate-output/refstruct-diagnostic-smoke.json
            work/mpeg2-candidate-output/mpeg2-accessory-smoke.json
            work/mpeg2-candidate-output/config_components.h
            work/mpeg2-candidate-output/LICENSE.*
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1

      - name: Retain MPEG2 corresponding source separately
        if: success() && inputs.core == 'within-mpeg2-candidate'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: private-mpeg2-source-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            work/mpeg2-candidate-output/corresponding-source.tar.gz
            work/mpeg2-candidate-output/configure.log
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1

      - name: Retain synthetic split frame contract only
        if: success() && inputs.core == 'within-mpeg2-split-contract'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: private-mpeg2-split-contract-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: outputs/reports/mpeg2-split-frame-contract.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1

      - name: Retain synthetic split properties contract only
        if: success() && inputs.core == 'within-mpeg2-split-properties'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: private-mpeg2-split-properties-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: outputs/reports/mpeg2-split-properties-contract.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1

      - name: Retain private separate encoder and initialization contract
        if: success() && inputs.core == 'within-mpeg2-split-encoder'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: private-mpeg2-split-encoder-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: work/mpeg2-split-encoder-output/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1

      - name: Retain private split production pipeline
        if: success() && inputs.core == 'within-mpeg2-split-pipeline'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: private-mpeg2-split-pipeline-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: work/mpeg2-split-pipeline-output/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1

      - name: Retain private aligned-reuse split candidate
        if: success() && inputs.core == 'within-mpeg2-aligned-reuse'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: private-mpeg2-aligned-reuse-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: work/mpeg2-split-pipeline-output/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1

      - name: Retain private arithmetic report only
        if: always() && inputs.core == 'within-h264-vaa-arithmetic'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: private-vaa-arithmetic-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: outputs/reports/vaa-arithmetic.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 1

      - name: Retain mismatched artifacts for bounded diagnosis
        if: failure() && inputs.core != 'within-h264-candidate' && inputs.core != 'within-mpeg2-candidate' && inputs.core != 'within-h264-vaa-arithmetic' && inputs.core != 'within-h264-sad-arithmetic' && inputs.core != 'within-mpeg2-split-contract' && inputs.core != 'within-mpeg2-split-properties' && inputs.core != 'within-mpeg2-split-encoder' && inputs.core != 'within-mpeg2-split-pipeline' && inputs.core != 'within-mpeg2-aligned-reuse'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ffmpeg-nondocker-mismatch-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: work/ffmpeg-nondocker-output/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1

      - name: Retain private SAD arithmetic report only
        if: always() && inputs.core == 'within-h264-sad-arithmetic'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: private-sad-arithmetic-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: outputs/reports/sad-arithmetic.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 1

      - name: Remove repository-local build data
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if test -L /src && test "$(readlink -f /src)" = \
              "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/work/ffmpeg-nondocker-build"; then
            sudo unlink /src
          fi
          if test -L /out && test "$(readlink -f /out)" = \
              "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/work/ffmpeg-nondocker-output"; then
            sudo unlink /out
          fi
          rm -rf -- \
            "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/work/emsdk" \
            "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/work/sdk-tmp" \
            "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/work/ffmpeg-nondocker-build" \
            "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/work/ffmpeg-nondocker-output"
          for task_path in "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/work/mpeg2-candidate-build" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/work/mpeg2-candidate-output" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/work/h264-candidate-build" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/work/h264-candidate-output" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/work/h264-vaa-arithmetic-build" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/work/h264-sad-arithmetic-build"; do
            case "$task_path" in
              "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/work/mpeg2-candidate-build"|"$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/work/mpeg2-candidate-output"|"$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/work/h264-candidate-build"|"$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/work/h264-candidate-output"|"$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/work/h264-vaa-arithmetic-build"|"$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/work/h264-sad-arithmetic-build") ;;
              *) exit 2 ;;
            esac
            rm -rf -- "$task_path"
          done
          task_path="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/work/mpeg2-split-frame-build"
          test "$task_path" = "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/work/mpeg2-split-frame-build" && ! test -L "$task_path"
          rm -rf -- "$task_path"
          task_path="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/work/mpeg2-split-properties-build"
          test "$task_path" = "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/work/mpeg2-split-properties-build" && ! test -L "$task_path"
          rm -rf -- "$task_path"
          task_path="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/work/mpeg2-split-encoder-build"
          test "$task_path" = "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/work/mpeg2-split-encoder-build" && ! test -L "$task_path"
          rm -rf -- "$task_path"
          task_path="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/work/mpeg2-split-encoder-output"
          test "$task_path" = "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/work/mpeg2-split-encoder-output" && ! test -L "$task_path"
          rm -rf -- "$task_path"
          task_path="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/work/mpeg2-split-pipeline-build"
          test "$task_path" = "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/work/mpeg2-split-pipeline-build" && ! test -L "$task_path"
          rm -rf -- "$task_path"
          task_path="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/work/mpeg2-split-pipeline-output"
          test "$task_path" = "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/work/mpeg2-split-pipeline-output" && ! test -L "$task_path"
          rm -rf -- "$task_path"

rationale: GitHub dispatch requires a workflow registered on default. Use existing registered core=within-mpeg2-aligned-reuse on this source-only isolated branch; its one builder command targets the new diagnostic, with original permissions/retention/cleanup unchanged.
